outcome: The `/portal/runtimes` page must render the adapter-independent capability members the workspace read already serves - `structured_input`, `provider_access`, `interactive` and `supervisory_control` - as readable rows inside the existing 'Advertised capabilities' section of every served runtime card, using the page's existing vocabulary and no new one: a served `true` renders 'Supported', a served `false` renders 'Not supported', and a member the record does not carry renders 'Not advertised' with the existing `unknown` chip tone. The rows must render for a runtime whose `capabilities.adapter` member is absent as well as for one that carries it: an adapter-less runtime keeps its existing 'Adapter record not advertised. This runtime reports no verified capability model, so no operation is claimed.' sentence and gains the four rows below it, because a legacy registration without adapter metadata serves only the boolean subset. A member the record does not carry must never be rendered from a substituted default (in particular, a missing `provider_access` is 'Not advertised', never 'Not supported'), and the rows must be readable without colour alone: each row stays addressable by its member name and the section keeps the heading that labels it. Nothing else changes: the adapter facts and the ten adapter operation rows, the page's empty states, the compatibility-filter copy and the refresh behaviour keep their current behaviour, and no existing test may be modified. Add your new cases in `frontend/src/features/runtimes/capability-rows.test.tsx`; the three cases must be declared at module level, outside any `describe` block, because the frozen named-test acceptance binds the reporter's full test name exactly: 'renders the four served boolean capabilities of an adapter-less runtime as rows', 'renders a capability member the record does not carry as Not advertised rather than Not supported' and 'keeps the adapter facts and operation rows when adapter metadata is served'.
explanations: Explain why the adapter-independent boolean members must render for a runtime whose adapter member is absent, and name the served projection and the frontend type member that carry them.
Explain how a member the record does not carry is rendered, and why that path cannot produce 'Not supported' for an absent member.
